csv_project_name: AE for Boettcher Concert Hall Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: The Denver Bond Office ( DBO ) and the Department of Transportation & Infrastructure ( DOTI ), City and County of Denver ( City ), has issued a Request for Qualifications (the RFQ ) for Boettcher Concert Hall Renovation Architectural & Engineering Design Services. The Boettcher Concert Hall Project will renovate the existing facility to address building systems and finishes that have exceeded their useful life. The project scope includes upgrades to HVAC, fire protection, life safety, data, technology, stage lighting, and audiovisual systems, along with new interior finishes, seating, and acoustic improvements.
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Site Evaluation/Selection, Acoustical/Noise Abatement Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering

title: A/E Services for Boettcher Concert Hall Renovation
short_description: Design services for renovating Denver's concert hall systems, interiors, acoustics, and structural components.
project_scope: Renovation of the existing Boettcher Concert Hall in Denver. The project addresses building systems and finishes that have exceeded their useful life. Scope includes upgrades to HVAC, fire protection, life safety, data and technology systems, stage lighting, audiovisual systems, new interior finishes, seating, and acoustic improvements. The notice also requests structural, civil, geotechnical, mechanical, electrical, fire protection, acoustical, and interior design services.
services: Architectural and engineering design services for renovation; requested disciplines include interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, site evaluation/selection, acoustical/noise abatement engineering, electrical engineering, fire protection engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Concert hall is a culturally significant public building, a project type of strategic interest to sbp.
- Includes structural engineering within a multidisciplinary renovation design scope.
- Acoustic and stage-related upgrades suggest technically demanding coordination in an architecturally sensitive venue.
- Early design-stage A/E procurement offers potential entry into the planning team.
- Relevance is reduced because the project is primarily a building renovation focused heavily on MEP and interiors rather than a clearly innovative long-span or special structural intervention.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available cost-related information: funding source is Bond November 2025; contract duration is 72.
